skills.name: Inspired Scholarship
skills.description:
Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every |cffffff3|r seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional |cffffff1678|r Magic Damage and generates Crux if you have none.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

skills.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
skills.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff3677|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff1553|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

skills.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
skills.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff1665|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff5488|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

skills.name: Stalwart Guard
skills.description:
Create a lifebond between you and an allied player. While bonded, |cffffff30|r% of the damage they take is instead redistributed to you.

You and your bonded ally also gain Minor Force, increasing your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%.

The bond will remain until you recast the spell or move more than |cffffff15|r meters away from your ally.

skills.name: Propelling Shield
skills.description:
Create a protective sphere over your location that reduces damage taken from siege weapons by |cffffff50|r% for you and nearby allies.

Also increases the range of abilities with a range greater than |cffffff28|r meters by |cffffff7|r meters. Does not affect Leap, Move Position, and Pull abilities.

skills.name: Soul Harvest
skills.description:
Ravage an enemy with a spinning attack, dealing |cffffff6668|r Magic Damage and increasing your damage against them by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff8|r seconds.

Also afflicts the enemy with Major Defile, reducing their healing received and damage shield strength by |cffffff12|r%.

While slotted on either bar, any time you kill an enemy you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
